from.place: The canonical finite-pointed-set projection used to state the symmetric infinity-operad assertions of module-operad-encoding.

title: Canonical pointed-set projection of the ordered left-module operad
statement: Use the ordered-fibre left-module operator category $\mathsf{LM}^{\otimes}$ and its nerve $L$ of [def-coef-left-module-operadic-encoding], and the finite-pointed-set category $\mathrm{Fin}_*$ and lifted nerve of [def-coef-relative-symmetric-operadic-algebras]. Define the forgetful functor $\mathsf{LM}^{\otimes}\to\mathrm{Fin}_*$ by sending a colour word of arity $n$ to $\langle n\rangle$, the basepoint to the basepoint, and an input to the output whose ordered fibre contains it, or to the basepoint if it occurs in no output fibre. Disjointness makes the output unique. Identity singleton fibres give identity maps, and ordered-fibre substitution gives composition of pointed maps. Its nerve is the canonical projection $L\to N(\mathrm{Fin}_*)$; no order or colour is retained.

source.place: Higher Algebra (2017), Notation 4.2.1.6 and Definition 4.2.1.7, canonical forgetful functor to Fin_*.
